description: This file defines a React context and hook for managing feature flags within a React application. It reads environment variables, processes them into a feature flags object, and provides access via context and a custom hook.

methods.name: FeatureFlagsProvider
methods.description: A React component that provides feature flags to its children by reading environment variables and memoizing the flags object.

methods.name: useFeatureFlags
methods.description: A custom React hook to access the current feature flags from context.
